rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B happens as soon as, when, or after A.

example.english: Once it rains, the roads get jammed.
example.jyutping: jat1 lok6 jyu5 zau6 sak1 ce1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for something happening one time, with 淨係 or 只係 added when the exclusivity of “only once” must be explicit.

example.english: I went to that restaurant once.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jat1 ci3

rows.note: Use this for a former period or an earlier state, especially when contrasting it with the present.

example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that something was true or happened at some point in the past, rather than simply saying it was earlier.

example.english: I once worked at that company.
example.traditional: 我曾經喺嗰間公司做過。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cang4 ging1 hai2 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 gwo3
